title: ALTER COLUMN for Fabric Data Warehouse (Preview)

content.text: ALTER TABLE ... ALTER COLUMN (Preview) lets you make supported schema changes directly on warehouse tables with familiar T-SQL syntax. Supported scenarios complete as metadata-only updates without rewriting Parquet files. For more information, see ALTER TABLE (Transact-SQL) syntax for warehouse in Fabric.
